correctness.rationale: With strict branch endpoints including F(0)=-s, a 3-cycle avoiding boundaries must have two sign-switching inner visits and one sign-preserving outer visit. Solving one positive-outer itinerary gives X=r(s²-s+1)/(rs²-1), Y=s(X-1), Z=s(Y+1); strict 0<X<1, -1<Y<0, 1<Z<s iff r(s-1)>1. Its odd symmetric partner is distinct; at equality exactly boundary cycle 0 -> -s -> -1 -> 0, and below no cycle. Return derivative rs²>4 because s>2, r>1/(s-1); inf 4 approached as s down to 2 and r up to 1, not achieved. Independent rational branch test at r=4/5,s=5 gives (84/95,-11/19,40/19) as asserted.
